text: {"verdict": "refuted", "answer": "The corpus directly contradicts the claim: in bovine SCNT embryos, global H3K9me3/2 hypermethylation is a barrier to reprogramming, and ectopic overexpression of the H3K9 demethylase KDM4E removes this mark and increases cloning efficiency, improves blastocyst formation, and restores the transcriptome. Thus removal of H3K9me3 by a demethylase increases, not decreases, SCNT reprogramming efficiency. The remaining excerpts concern H3K4 methylation and HDAC inhibition in iPSC reprogramming and do not support the claim either.", "evidence_used": ["4547102"]}
